text:
Sports
Rémy Trégourès advances to second round at Mountain West tennis championships
Rémy Trégourès has moved into the second round at the Mountain West tennis championships after a decisive win. Other Nevada players faced early exits in both singles and doubles play.
Rémy Trégourès advanced to the second round of the men's singles draw at the 2026 Credit Union 1 Fall Men's and Women's Tennis Championships presented by Palms Casino Resort Wednesday in Las Vegas.
Trégourès, who is seeded fourth in the men's singles draw, defeated Kent Mueller of Hawai'i 6-1, 6-1 during the morning session. He is scheduled to face Brice Patoux from Grand Canyon University in Thursday's second round at 9:30 a.m. at Darling Tennis Center.
Other results for Nevada on Wednesday included Greg Valente losing to Nikos Lehmann of Grand Canyon University 6-2, 6-2; Ibrahim Snoussi falling to Daniel Jankoski of Grand Canyon University 6-2, 6-4; and Axel Huysmans being defeated by Soeren Grandke of Hawai'i 6-3, 6-3.
In men's doubles action during the Round of 16, Nadaul Cheam and Cyrus Ahmed from UC Davis beat Nicolas Recoura and Rémy Trégourès from Nevada with a score of 8-6. Additionally, Daniel Jankoski and Charlie Pade from Grand Canyon University advanced against Axel Huysmans and Sebastiano Cressi from Nevada via walkover.
The schedule for Thursday includes Rémy Trégourès facing Brice Patoux in singles competition.
